neighbours.label: the person or thing told something, after tell or vow (vowing to her distraught parents that, tells search engines not to, tells his classes), as opposed to the same nouns with no telling
fire: He found the boy, promising his worried parents that he would return.
The router tells the packets of data where to go.
This tag tells search engines not to index the page.
She tells her cooking classes that salt comes last.
The nurse told the anxious family that he was stable.
The sign tells drivers of trucks to slow down.
He assured his nervous investors that the money was safe.
Our coach tells his young players to keep calm.
